scope: All spatially intersecting records in the published NRW historic tile catalogue, corroborated against its original WFS layer and NRW-linked ArcGIS catalogue; comparison with canonical national 1 m data. Not a claim about unpublished surveys or a raster-validity inventory.

reconstruction.note: Reconstruction spacing is resampling, not a finer LiDAR acquisition. Padded-extent WFS hits also returned the same count of eight; primary coverage uses the canonical vertex/reference domain.

authority.crs_handling: Primary WFS geometries and canonical AOI are both EPSG:27700; no coordinate transformation is required. ArcGIS corroboration explicitly declares inSR/outSR 27700 and the server returns wkid 27700; its native 3857 geometry is not used for coverage calculations.

authority.resolution_units_evidence: NRW-linked ArcGIS popup labels RESOLUTION as Resolution (m); historic metadata describes DTM/DSM raster resolutions. All eight returned values are 1. No sub-metre candidate requires raster-header verification.

coverage_method.normalisation: Each raw polygon must be a single closed four-corner rectangle within 1 mm of its nominal integer-metre OS bounds. Raw coordinates are retained. Maximum observed deviation is below 0.00014 m. A scanline rectangle union prevents double counting.
coverage_method.grouping: Original POLYGON_ID plus acquisition interval and resolution identify survey groups; LIDAR_NAME identifies individual tile records. All records within each returned POLYGON_ID share dates/resolution.
coverage_method.coverage_warning: Tile footprints locate archive entries, not the spatial arrangement of measured/valid cells. PERCENT_CO is labelled Percent Coverage in the NRW web map and is retained as a whole-tile percentage; it must not be applied directly to the AOI intersection. No historical raster mask or actual swath polygon was retrieved.
coverage_method.conditional_upper_bound_assumption: If PERCENT_CO measures valid coverage of the nominal 4,000,000 m² tile, each tile can contribute at most min(AOI intersection area, tile area × PERCENT_CO/100). Sum these maxima for each survey; these are bounds, not measured AOI percentages. Rounded source percentages limit precision.

combined_historic_tile_union.warning: 100% is the union of tile rectangles across different surveys, not proof of continuous LiDAR coverage.

download_verification.method: HEAD only; no ZIP or raster payload downloaded

current_canonical_source.coverage_evidence: Canonical retained raster manifest: 9,000,000 valid cells and zero nodata cells for each 3000×3000 DTM/DSM; live national catalogue agrees on date and full tile union. Raster payloads were not re-read.

best_available_dtm.coverage_basis: retained canonical valid-cell metadata; live tile catalogue corroboration

best_available_dsm.coverage_basis: retained canonical valid-cell metadata; live tile catalogue corroboration

recommendation.next_data_action: Retain the existing 2021 1 m DTM/DSM. No finer historic acquisition is identified for this AOI, so do not download or migrate historic rasters for a resolution improvement. If acquisition-to-acquisition comparison is later needed, first establish the historic valid-data masks.

uncertainties: The published tile index cannot establish the exact historical valid-cell/swath intersection inside each tile; historical actual AOI coverage remains null rather than guessed.
PERCENT_CO is present only in the original catalogue/NRW web map. Its whole-tile value cannot tell where covered cells lie within the AOI.
Catalogue absence does not prove absence of unpublished or unindexed data. Conclusions are scoped to the queried official published archive.
The 2007 dates are the recorded survey interval 2007-02-07 to 2007-04-02, not an exact per-tile flight day.
HEAD 200 establishes reachable objects, not ZIP/raster integrity or actual nodata masks. No source rasters were downloaded.

errors_and_recovery.recovery: Official layer-specific capabilities returned HTTP 200; DescribeFeatureType and bounded GetFeature/hits succeeded.
One CQL expression combining BBOX(geom,...) AND resolution < 1 succeeded with numberMatched 0.
